Simulation models copied unchanged from the GlobalFoundries GF180MCU open PDK
(github.com/google/globalfoundries-pdk-libs-gf180mcu_fd_io and
github.com/google/globalfoundries-pdk-ip-gf180mcu_fd_ip_sram, Apache-2.0), so the
testbench runs without a PDK installation. The layout flow uses the installed PDK, not these copies.
